description: This file implements the MiracastRTSPMsg class, which handles RTSP message processing for Miracast streaming, including request parsing, response generation, socket communication, and state management. It contains definitions for various RTSP message formats, validation routines, and socket handling functions. The class manages the RTSP protocol exchange necessary for Miracast streaming sessions.
